title: Generate and send an Analysis Log
desc:
### How to Generate and Send an Analysis Log
To help us diagnose your issue, please follow these steps carefully:
1. **Download the Analysis Batch**
> Click this link to download the file:
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1486055444223885375/1521271601583362201/analysis.bat

> Go to your desktop, find the file called **`Madium_Analysis.txt`**, and drag & drop it into this ticket. This file contains important information that will help us understand what's going wrong.
If you have any questions or run into issues while following these steps, feel free to ask for help!

title: How to replace bin folder
desc:
# How to replace bin folder
- Go to %localappdata%/Madium by using the run panel (windows + r to open run)
- Delete the Bin folder inside
- Download and extract the Bin folder from the given gofile link: https://gofile.io/d/ySADPi
- Drag and drop the extracted Bin folder to the Madium folder where you deleted the previous Bin.
P.S. If you don't have the Bin folder inside, drag and drop the new Bin folder.

title: Fix for corrupted WebViewV2 files
desc:
# Fix for corrupted WebViewV2 files:
- Firstly, go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft
- Then delete the folder named "EdgeWebView"
- After that, copy the "Edge" file into the same folder you are in right now. Now you will have a folder named "Edge - Copy"
- Rename that "Edge - Copy" folder to "EdgeWebView"
You are good to go now!

title: Add exclusions on Windows Security
desc:
# How to add exclusions on Windows Security:
## Firstly, open Windows Security.
Navigate to Privacy & Security → Windows Security → Virus & threat protection
## Secondly, go to Exclusion Settings.
Click "Manage settings" under Virus & threat protection settings. Then, scroll down to the Exclusions section. Click "Add or remove exclusions". Press yes when prompted to give administrator permissions.
## Thirdly, add the Folders:
### Adding C:/Users/%username%/Downloads:
Click "+ Add an exclusion"
Select "Folder" from the dropdown
In the folder path bar at the top, type:
`C:/Users/%username%/Downloads`
Click "Select Folder"
### Adding %LocalAppData%/Madium/Bin:
Click "+ Add an exclusion"
Select "Folder" from the dropdown
In the folder path bar at the top, type:
`%LocalAppData%/Madium/Bin`
Then, press enter and click "Select Folder".
### Adding %temp%:
Click "+ Add an exclusion"
Select "Folder" from the dropdown
In the folder path bar at the top, type:
`%temp%`
Then, press enter and click "Select Folder".
## You are good to go now!
Video attached as well to make it easier for you to understand how to do it.
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/873778414371368993/1495743508676481094/How_to_put_exclusions.mp4

title: Exclusions for inbound/outbound requests
desc:
# How to put exclusions for inbound and outbound requests in your firewall
## Video attached with it at the end, read both texts and watch the video to understand how to do it.
## Opening firewall
- Search Firewall on the windows search bar.
- Open "Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security"
## Inbound requests
Press **Inbound Requests** on the left sidebar
Then press **New Rule** on the right sidebar
### The next process will repeat 3 times for each path:
1. Select program then press next;
2. Put the path of the program then press next;
3. Press allow the connection and press next;
4. Make sure all options are checked/tick-marked: Domain, Private and Public | After that press next
5. Add a name according the .exe file that you selected from that particular path.
### All 3 paths for **Inbound Requests**:
- C:\Users\Your Username\AppData\Roaming\Madium\Bin\Loader.exe
- C:\Users\Your Username\AppData\Roaming\Madium\Bin\Madium.exe
- Location of where you put your madium-launcher.exe, find it through the browse section.
## Outbound requests
Press **Outbound Requests** on the left sidebar
Then press **New Rule** on the right sidebar
### The next process will repeat 3 times for each path:
1. Select **Program** then press next;
2. Put the path of the program then press next;
3. Press **Allow the connection** and press next;
4. Make sure all options are checked/tick-marked: Domain, Private and Public | After that press next
5. Add a name according the .exe file that you selected from that particular path.
### All 3 paths for Outbound Requests:
- C:\Users\Your Username\AppData\Roaming\Madium\Bin\Loader.exe
- C:\Users\Your Username\AppData\Roaming\Madium\Bin\Madium.exe
- Location of where you put your madium-launcher.exe, find it through the browse section.
Video tutorial on how to do it: https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1486058139508932608/1495916476425568416/How_to_put_firewall_exclusions.mp4?ex=69e7fc48&is=69e6aac8&hm=8e987970a7

title: vpn
desc:
It seems like you got some connection issue, please download and try using WARP at https://one.one.one.one.
Make sure to select **Traffic and DNS (UDP)** before connecting to the WARP service.
If not working, consider using another VPN of your choice.

Don't have VPN? Try this method (**Only for Windows 11**):

1. Open **Windows Settings**.

2. Click **Network & Internet** and click **Ethernet**.

3. Search **DNS Server assignment:** and click **Edit**.

4. Change **Automatic (DCHP)** to **Manual**.

5. Set **Preferred DNS** to either **`1.1.1.1`** or **`8.8.8.8`** (Choose one!)

6. Set **Alternate DNS** to either **`1.0.0.1`** or **`8.8.4.4`** (Choose one!)

7. Set Both **DNS over HTTPS** for both Preferred and Alternate DNS to **On (Automatic Template)**.

8. Click **Save** and type **`ipconfig /flushdns`** inside **cmd.exe**.

9. Now try again, it should fixed the connection issue.

title: rdd
desc:
Please follow these steps to use RDD Roblox.

1. Go to **[RDD Website by WEAO](https://rdd.weao.xyz)**

2. Click **Download Latest** or you can specify the Roblox Version that Madium recommends (for downgrade).

3. Wait until the website give you the ZIP file.

4. Extract `WEAO-Live-WindowsPlayer-version-***.zip` to `C:\Users\yourname\AppData\Local\Roblox\Versions` (**if Roblox or Roblox\Versions not found, create it manually**). If you extract it as the file name, rename the folder and remove `WEAO-Live-WindowsPlayer-`, so your final folder name look like this `version-***`.

5. Open **Madium**, go to **Versions** (Download Icon) and **Patch** Roblox.

6. Now launch it, it should fix the issue.

Here is the video detailing on https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1357645414337347616/1541842637806510130/How_to_use_RDD.mp4?ex=6a8f105a&is=6a8dbeda&hm=3d812a2ce1c1547758e2d14473c66d830d98025c2de819bafc66dd594b030cdc&
